questions.q: What does this lesson say about whether there's a single, standardized ServiceNow interview process?
options: ServiceNow itself publishes an official required interview script for employers
Every ServiceNow employer uses the exact same three-stage process
Only recruiter screens exist; technical interviews are rare in this field
There isn't one — format varies a lot by company size, role level, and consulting vs. in-house
questions.explain: The lesson is explicit that format varies enormously, and names recurring formats rather than one universal script.

questions.q: What is the recruiter or HR screen primarily checking for?
options: Deep CMDB data modeling knowledge
Basic fit, availability, compensation range, and obvious disqualifiers — not technical depth
Whether you can pass the CTA design defense
Your ability to write a live Business Rule under time pressure
questions.explain: The recruiter screen is a real gate but rarely technical in depth; it's checking fit and logistics.

questions.q: What kind of questions should a candidate expect in the hiring-manager interview, per this lesson?
options: Questions exclusively about salary expectations
Scenario-based questions like "walk me through how you'd design X", not rapid-fire trivia
Only yes/no questions about ServiceNow modules
A written, multiple-choice certification-style exam
questions.explain: This format rewards stating a real tradeoff and explaining why one approach was chosen over another, not reciting definitions.

questions.q: What does a live platform exercise or take-home scenario mainly test, according to this lesson?
options: Your performance on a timed multiple-choice quiz
Whether you've memorized every system property name
Being comfortable narrating your own thinking out loud while building something, not memorizing syntax
Typing speed inside the ServiceNow platform
questions.explain: The honest preparation is being able to narrate your reasoning clearly while working, the same skill built in Chapter 6's defense exercises.

questions.q: What's a reasonable way to figure out which interview formats you're likely to face for a specific role?
options: Assume every ServiceNow employer runs the identical three-stage process
Read the job posting and anything the recruiter says about the process, and ask directly if it's unclear
There's no way to know anything in advance
Only large enterprises ever conduct technical interviews
questions.explain: Posting language and recruiter conversations are real signal, and asking the recruiter directly about the process is a reasonable, normal question.
